meta.claim_boundary: Manual guidance ablation only; not an extraction-agent output.

skills.trigger: question concerns trend, growth, or change over time
skills.action: Do not test only the overall total. Decompose the trend by the primary categorical columns of this dataset ({categorical_columns}) and report both overall and per-group trends.
skills.rationale: An aggregate trend can mask or invert subgroup behaviour.

skills.trigger: question concerns imbalance, distribution, or concentration
skills.action: Check whether the pattern holds uniformly across time and the categorical groups of this dataset ({categorical_columns}); report overall results and notable per-group deviations.
skills.rationale: Aggregate distributions hide where an imbalance is concentrated.

skills.trigger: aggregating or testing a trend over a time column
skills.action: Choose a time granularity that leaves enough observations per bucket. Use the schema time range and bucket counts; avoid a granularity where most buckets are nearly empty.
skills.rationale: Trend tests on sparse buckets produce noise rather than signal.

skills.trigger: self-evaluating whether findings answer the research goal
skills.action: Check every goal-relevant quantity, trend, or comparison across time and the available categorical dimensions ({categorical_columns}), not only as one overall number. Treat unexamined entity-by-dimension slices as missing aspects.
skills.rationale: Coverage failures are often unexamined entity-by-dimension slices.

skills.trigger: about to declare the research goal sufficiently answered
skills.action: Before setting sufficient=true, try to name at least two goal-relevant analytical slices that remain unexamined. If any exists, continue and record it in missing_aspects.
skills.rationale: The common self-evaluation failure is stopping too early.
